what: When the photo or video covering the screen switches to another, the panel is split into a 5×5 grid and the new image enters cell by cell in the order each cell crosses a noise threshold. Midway through ((4p(1-p))²) the image shifts diagonally by up to 15% and red and blue split apart by 2.5% before returning (WebGL). When nothing is changing, the shader rests and the image is left as is.

options.on: Handle selector that switches on hover (on tap for touch) — anywhere in the document, with data-key holding which picture it is (counting from 0). If absent, the script sends an fx:goto event (detail number) to el.
options.drift: Speed at which the push direction drifts, default .04

use: … Second

from.where: shared.js full-screen video stage (.t-stage) — hovering a contents cell switches to that project’s video

note: Images must come from the same origin (or allow CORS) for WebGL to read them. If called again mid-change, only the target is updated and it continues when finished (as in the original). Video slots play when they come in and pause when they leave. With reduced motion, it switches immediately
